description: This source file contains utility functions for parsing command-line arguments related to test execution, including managing options and file filters, as well as defining constants for recognized test options.

methods.name: parsePassthroughArgs
methods.description: Parses an array of command-line arguments, separating file filters from option arguments, considering options that take values.

methods.name: countExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Counts the number of file filters provided in the command-line arguments.

methods.name: getExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Retrieves the list of file filter arguments from the command-line arguments.
